depiction.primary_object: square note or sticker with folded corner and smiley face

ambiguity: Combines the standard glyph for a sticky note (square with folded corner) and a chat sticker (peeling corner with a smiley face), so it can be read as either physical stationery, a decal, or a digital sticker pack.

modifier_semantics.meaning: peeling adhesive sticker or paper note
sticker graphic, emoji, or cheerful message

reasoning: Shows a square sheet with a curled corner and a tilted grinning face, the standard UI icon for stickers (both physical decals and messaging-app stickers) as well as cheerful sticky notes. It fits tasks around buying, designing, applying, or removing stickers and Post-it notes, though plain note-taking is better served by a standard document or notepad icon.
